scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run test:capacitor-foundation && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.check: pnpm run check:codegen && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.check:codegen: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen && git diff --exit-code -- lib/api-client-react/src lib/api-zod/src
scripts.build:static-client: pnpm run check:static-client-boundary && pnpm run test:static-client-output && pnpm --filter @workspace/static-client run build
scripts.cap:sync: pnpm run build:mobile-web && pnpm exec cap sync
scripts.android:run: pnpm run cap:sync && pnpm exec cap run android
scripts.ios:build: pnpm run cap:sync && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode-beta.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:run: pnpm run cap:sync && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode-beta.app/Contents/Developer pnpm exec cap run ios
